title: jackchammons / sites
tagline: Static sites, each built from data by a script and redeployed on a schedule.

sites.name: The Seattle Pizza Index
sites.tagline: Seattle's pizzerias, tracked daily: a ranked top ten and a full directory, scored by SLICE, a published five-factor method with every input shown.

sites.name: Odyssey 70mm Seat Maps
sites.tagline: Seat availability for The Odyssey in 70mm at SIFF Cinema Downtown — captured seat maps, percent-sold trend, and sold-out tracking across the engagement.

emptyIndex.title: Odyssey 70mm Seat Maps
emptyIndex.heading: No 70mm screenings currently listed
emptyIndex.body: The last scheduled capture found nothing to report. This page refreshes automatically when screenings go back on sale.

sites.name: Now
sites.tagline: A live clock: the time and date rendered large, with the ISO timestamp, Unix epoch, week number, progress through the day and year, and a rack of world clocks.

sites.name: Mortgage Calculator
sites.tagline: A mortgage calculator: monthly payment with taxes, insurance, PMI and HOA, the full amortization schedule, and what extra principal saves you.

sites.name: Life
sites.tagline: Conway's Game of Life, running from a random seed the moment the page opens: a white grid, black cells, forever.

sites.name: Screen & Seat
sites.tagline: TV and projector sizing: how far to sit for each standard, field of view, pixel visibility, screen dimensions by aspect ratio, throw distance and mounting height.
